about: Round 5 (main 2026-10-15): one rule set for every reader of a child's spoken number (src/duplex/numerals.ts valuesOf, server/duplex/understand.js valuesIn, server/grading/spoken-number.js). Rules: (1) '<number> बटा <number>' is a fraction, as Roman 'bata' already is; (2) '<number> बता <number>' (azure-speech's spelling of बटा, 6/6 fraction answers on the owner harness) is a fraction only between two number words; (3) Devanagari 'दो' right after a verb stem (बता, समझा, दिखा, सुना, कर, दे, लिख, बोल, सिखा, बना; never घटा / जोड़, which are arithmetic) is the verb 'give', not 2, unless rule 1 or 2 claims it as a denominator. 'values' = every value read, in order; a fraction as 'a/b', an integer as its digits.
